items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: Pierre Nourie, the women Pernacier, is the one that started the Hot Club of France.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Pierre Nourie, the women Pernacier, is the one that started the Hot Club of France. And so I used to go to the house and listen to the ladies and things they had.
And so, you certainly had an odd life. I mean, it's been different.
